title: Esculin inhibits hepatic stellate cell activation and CCl(4)-induced liver fibrosis by activating the Nrf2/GPX4 signaling pathway.
authors: Xu, Shuoxi; Chen, Yonger; Miao, Jindian; Li, Yuhua; Liu, Jiaying; Zhang, Jing; Liang, Jian; Chen, Shuxian; Hou, Shaozhen
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究秦皮乙素通过Nrf2/GPX4通路抑制肝星状细胞活化与肝纤维化，属纯湿实验药理学研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Liver fibrosis (LF) is a pathological process of the liver that threatens human health. Currently, effective treatments are still lacking. Esculin, a prominent constituent found in the Fraxinus rhynchophylla. (bark), Aesculus hippocastanum. (bark), and Cichorium intybus. (herb), has been shown to possess significant anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties. However, to date, there have been no studies investigating its potential efficacy in the treatment of LF. OBJECTIVE: The study aims to investigate the therapeutic effect of esculin on LF and elucidate its potential molecular mechanism. METHODS: Carbon tetrachloride (CCl(4)) was injected intraperitoneally to induce LF in mice, and transforming growth factor beta1 (TGF-beta1) was injected to induce LX-2 cells to investigate the improvement effect of esculin on LF. Kit, histopathological staining, immunohistochemistry (IHC), immunofluorescence (IF), polymerase chain reaction (PCR), and western blot (WB) were used to detect the expression of fiber markers and nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2)/glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) signaling pathway in liver tissue and LX-2 cells. Finally, molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) were used to verify the targeting between Nrf2 and esculin. RESULTS: Esculin significantly inhibited CCl(4)-induced hepatic fibrosis and inflammation in mice. This was evidenced by the improvement of liver function indexes, fibrosis indicators, and histopathology. Additionally, esculin treatment prominently reduced the levels of pro-inflammatory factors, oxidative stress, and liver Fe(2+) in CCl(4)-induced mice. In vitro studies also showed that esculin treatment significantly inhibited TGF-beta1-induced LX-2 cell activation and decreased alpha-smooth muscle actin (alpha-SMA) and collagen I expression. Mechanism experiments proved that esculin can activate the Nrf2/GPX4 signaling pathway and inhibit liver ferroptosis. However, when LX-2 cells were treated with the Nrf2 inhibitor (ML385), the therapeutic effect of esculin significantly decreased. CONCLUSION: This study is the first to demonstrate that esculin is a potential natural active ingredient in the treatment of LF, which can inhibit the activation of hepatic stellate cells (HSC) and improve LF. Its therapeutic effect is related to the activation of the Nrf2/GPX4 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝纤维化（LF）是一种威胁人类健康的肝脏病理过程，目前仍缺乏有效治疗方法。秦皮苷（Esculin）是白蜡树（Fraxinus rhynchophylla）树皮、欧洲七叶树（Aesculus hippocastanum）树皮和菊苣（Cichorium intybus）草本中的一种主要成分，已被证明具有显著的抗炎、抗氧化和抗菌特性。然而，迄今为止，尚无研究探讨其在LF治疗中的潜在疗效。目的：本研究旨在探讨秦皮苷对LF的治疗效果，并阐明其潜在的分子机制。方法：通过腹腔注射四氯化碳（CCl(4)）诱导小鼠LF，并注射转化生长因子β1（TGF-beta1）诱导LX-2细胞，以研究秦皮苷对LF的改善作用。使用试剂盒、组织病理学染色、免疫组织化学（IHC）、免疫荧光（IF）、聚合酶链反应（PCR）和蛋白质印迹（WB）检测肝组织和LX-2细胞中纤维化标志物及核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）/谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）信号通路的表达。最后，使用分子对接、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）验证Nrf2与秦皮苷之间的靶向关系。结果：秦皮苷显著抑制了CCl(4)诱导的小鼠肝纤维化和炎症，这通过肝功能指标、纤维化指标和组织病理学的改善得到证实。此外，秦皮苷处理显著降低了CCl(4)诱导小鼠中促炎因子水平、氧化应激和肝脏Fe(2+)含量。体外研究也表明，秦皮苷处理显著抑制了TGF-beta1诱导的LX-2细胞活化，并降低了α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（alpha-SMA）和胶原蛋白I的表达。机制实验证明，秦皮苷能激活Nrf2/GPX4信号通路并抑制肝脏铁死亡。然而，当LX-2细胞用Nrf2抑制剂（ML385）处理时，秦皮苷的治疗效果显著降低。结论：本研究首次证明秦皮苷是治疗LF的潜在天然活性成分，能抑制肝星状细胞（HSC）活化并改善LF，其治疗作用与激活Nrf2/GPX4信号通路相关。
